notablePrerequisites:
Reflection of Kiki-Jiki and Goldspan Dragon do not have summoning sickness.
Goldspan Dragon cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
description:
Activate Reflection of KIki-Jiki by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant with haste.
Declare Goldspan Dragon and Combat Celebrant token as an attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebbrant as it attacks.
The token triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Goldspan Dragon deals combat damage to a player, causing you to create a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

uses.name: Fable of the Mirror-Breaker // Reflection of Kiki-Jiki
